verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents on-demand deployments on dedicated GPUs whose performance is 'unaffected by other users', distinct from the shared serverless pool. Autoscaling is configurable via firectl, covering replica counts, scale-up/down windows, scale-to-zero and load targets. All of this comes from first-party docs only; missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation and autoscaling behavior.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool

citations.quote: On-demand deployments give you dedicated GPUs for your models, providing several advantages over serverless: Better performance – Lower latency, higher throughput, and predictable performance unaffected by other users
On-demand deployments are dedicated GPUs that give you better performance, no rate limits, fast autoscaling, and a wider selection of models than serverless.
Configure replica counts, scale-up/down windows, scale-to-zero, and load targets for on-demand Fireworks deployments using firectl flags.
